Author: Null
Name: Chocobo Color Calculator
Punchline: Plan and track an accurate chocobo color feeding route in game.
Description: Calculates and tracks ordered fruit routes between companion chocobo colors.
Changelog: Locked every calculation to the reliable-target algorithm, added exact algebraic route ordering and stronger 7,225-pair verification, removed redundant calculation/list modes, and completely redesigned the UI with animated gradients, translucent glass panels, modern controls, and one streamlined route view.
